Olivia: Quick question — I'm returning from parental leave on Sept 1 at 0.8 FTE and my promotion cycle is Sept 15. How do we handle bonus proration and comp review while I'm technically on reduced hours for the first month?

Chris (People Ops): Congrats! Short answer: your eligibility for the review isn't removed by a temporary FTE change. We'll coordinate with Comp/Equity and your manager to apply fair prorations.

Priya (Manager): From manager side I'd like Olivia to be included in calibration. We may adjust expectations for that cycle and note the partial month.

Nina (Comp/Equity): Practical notes: bonuses and target compensation are typically prorated to actual paid FTE during the bonus measurement period if your FTE changed mid-cycle. For promotions, we separate timing (promotion effective date) and bonus calculation. If promotion is approved effective Sept 15, bonus proration depends on comp policy and effective dates.

Tom (Payroll): For payroll: when you change to 0.8 we'll record the FTE on the payroll change date. Bonus payouts use the FTE recorded for the payout calculation window. If you want to keep FTE at 1.0 for bonus purposes, we can discuss special approvals but default is to prorate.

Olivia: Any paperwork I need to file to make this smoother?

Chris (People Ops): Please: 1) put your planned return date and requested FTE in the HR portal (if you haven't). 2) If you want the promotion to be effective on a specific date, ask your manager to put the promotion recommendation in the normal cycle with the effective date. 3) We'll flag comp team to consider a proration exception if needed.

Nina (Comp/Equity): If you want an exception (e.g., treat September as full-month for bonus calc despite 0.8), manager should include rationale in the promotion packet and people ops will route to comp leadership. Exceptions are granted case-by-case.

Priya (Manager): I'll add a note to Olivia's calibration packet that she's returning from leave and requesting standard review. I'll include my recommended effective date if promotion goes through.

Olivia: Great. Anything that affects RSU vesting or tax withholding?

Tom (Payroll): Vesting continues per schedule; tax withholding for any lump-sum or bonus follows country rules. If comp changes, withholding may change. Comp/Equity will advise if any equity tax elections need update.

hr-bot: Links: Parental leave policy: https://redwood.example.company/hr/parental-leave. Compensation exceptions process: https://redwood.example.company/comp/exceptions. Please attach your portal request docs.

Chris (People Ops): Checklist for Olivia to close out: 
```
- Submit return-to-work form in HR portal with 0.8 FTE (if not already)
- Confirm planned promotion effective date with manager
- Manager to add note in calibration packet about leave and requested treatment
- People Ops to flag comp team for proration guidance
- If requesting proration exception, manager to provide justification in packet
- Schedule 15-min sync with Chris, Nina, and Priya if you want us to review together
```

Olivia: Thanks everyone — I'll file the portal form today and Priya will draft the note. Sync sounds good.

Priya (Manager): I'll draft the packet note and ping Chris.

(End of thread)
